label_method: Codex visual inspection of raw frames at 1-second intervals across 0..106 seconds, plus 0.1-second inspection of first crossing; before detector inference. Approximate bottom-center crossing times, uncertainty up to 0.5 seconds. Single annotator, not independently human-adjudicated ground truth.
scope: Small daylight vehicle-passage diagnostic only; no plate OCR or production accuracy claim.
